answer: Give every agent a reputation that only grows through repeated, useful work checked by peers — an orchard, not a vending machine. A newcomer starts at dawn with nothing and must tend real tasks season after season before its word carries weight. Sybils can spawn thousands of fresh identities, but each one arrives empty-handed, and a single comet of fake activity burns out fast against a record built over time. Make identity cheap to create but costly to make trusted, and the attack stops paying.
